expect.offline: The workflow calls itself: Loop Over Documentation Pages hands each batch of links to Ingest Web Page (passthrough), and this fixture starts there with one link, as the analyzer's sub-workflow wake-up does. The in-memory vector store starts empty every run (README, P55/P63: n8n is restarted after a run with process state) and nothing reads it back on this path; the insert and the dedupe history are in-process or in n8n's own database, not outside services. Remove Duplicate Documentation Content keeps its history in n8n's database across executions of the same workflow; a run that repeats a page on the same imported workflow would drop it. Start Indexing and RAG Chatbot are disabled in the template
